PARA:
Information Mode Functions
Pressing the "Information/G" panel switch changes to the Information/G screen, where each information display can be selected. In addition, the information page can be displayed by touching the "Information" TAB on the Information/G screen.
Information Screen
Information Screen Function List
Item (Touch Switch) Description
Telephone Display of traffic/navigation related information
Display of hands-free screen
Congestion Prediction Display of traffic congestion forecast information
VICS Display of VICS graphic information and text information, display of interrupt information
Selection of VICS broadcasting stations
FM Multiplex Display of FM multiplex broadcasting
ETC Display of ETC screen
Calendar Display of calendar
Operation Guide Display of application operating instructions
